# AI Posture

> The Aggregated Intelligence Posture framework. Where your organization stands on AI governance, across three vectors, bounded by the weakest.

AI governance is three problems, not one. How effectively your people collaborate with AI (People vector). How ready your digital presence is for AI agents (Infrastructure vector). How prepared you are for AI-specific regulation (Regulation vector). An organization's AI Posture (also called Aggregated Intelligence Posture) is bounded by its weakest in-scope vector.

The spec is CC BY 4.0. Reference implementations are MIT. Stewardship and governance are documented in the spec.

## Concepts

- AI Posture (formally Aggregated Intelligence Posture): A unified governance score for human-AI collaboration, computed as the minimum over in-scope vectors.
- Three vectors (v1.0): People (human-AI collaboration), Infrastructure (agent-readiness of digital presence), Regulation (AI-specific compliance readiness).
- Five-level maturity model: N/A, Perceiving, Assessing, Integrating, Calibrating, Engineering. Level 0 is a falsifiable scope boundary. A contradicted N/A declaration invalidates the assertion.
- Constraint rule: AI Posture equals the minimum of the in-scope vector levels. Structural, not a scoring choice. N/A vectors are excluded from the minimum.
- Constraining vector: The lowest in-scope vector. Advancing it raises the aggregate.
- Decay and freshness: Every AI Posture report is a time-stamped assertion. Assessors stamp a next-review date. Readers weight older scores as weaker signals.

## Pre-assessment

- Runtime: https://aiposture.org/assess/
- Shape: Bayesian adaptive. Three openers set scope and prior. Up to five adaptive questions per in-scope vector, stopping early when a level's posterior crosses 0.70.
- Output: Estimated AI Posture aggregate, per-vector posterior (point estimate with full distribution on hover), constraining vector, evidence checklist per vector.
- Privacy: Client-side. Answers in sessionStorage. No cookies. Aggregate analytics only (PostHog in cookie-less mode, no autocapture, no session recording). No personal identifiers.
- Labeling: Output is labeled "estimated AI Posture," never "verified" or "assessed."

- [SPEC.md](https://github.com/snapsynapse/ai-posture/blob/main/SPEC.md): Normative specification (v0.3.2)
- [PRD.md](https://github.com/snapsynapse/ai-posture/blob/main/PRD.md): Pre-assessment product requirements (v0.1.2)
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/snapsynapse/ai-posture/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Spec change log
- [Landing page](https://aiposture.org/): Canonical homepage
- [Self-assessment](https://aiposture.org/assess/): Bayesian adaptive pre-assessment
- [Assistant Guide](https://aiposture.org/.well-known/assistant-guide.txt): bounded assistant maintenance instructions
- [Assistant Guide Manifest](https://aiposture.org/.well-known/assistant-guide-manifest.json): GuideCheck Level 4 sidecar manifest
- [Framework Profile](https://aiposture.org/.well-known/ai-posture-framework.json): machine-readable framework terms, vectors, levels, and key agent resources
- [Estimate Result Schema](https://aiposture.org/assess/schema/estimate-result.schema.json): JSON Schema for downloadable pre-assessment estimate artifacts
- [Privacy policy](https://aiposture.org/privacy/): Data handling, retention, cookie-less analytics posture
- [Terms of service](https://aiposture.org/terms/): License terms (CC BY 4.0 spec, MIT code), beta notice, warranty disclaimers
